test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the following indirect sentence into direct speech. Choose the most accurate option.

The coach said that the players must arrive early.

options.text: The coach said, "The players must arrive early."
The coach said, "They should arrive early."
The coach said, "They are arriving early."
The coach said, "The players will arrive early."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The coach said that the players must arrive early.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Modal Verb ("must"):**
 
 
• In indirect speech, **"must"** can remain &l
